text:
Mira Patel: opened small PR to tidy Tilde-8B model card: fix links, clarify seq limits, and update SDK snippet to v3. https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/881
Evan Ortiz: quick scan 1: looks fine. Please call out the difference between model max_context=8k (default) and the 32k long-context variant. Folks confuse them.
Mira Patel: added a short callout under 'Limits' and a one-liner in the overview.
Dana Kim: bench numbers reference A100s + runtime v1.13. Can we add a parenthetical noting this and create a follow-up ticket for v1.14 re-runs?
Mira Patel: added "(benchmarks on a100, runtime v1.13)" and created INF-1920 to re-run on v1.14, linked in PR.
Evan Ortiz: SDK snippet used old param max_seq. Updated to max_length and tested streaming locally.
Samira (docs-bot): linkcheck: 2 broken anchors. Recommended replacements: /docs/embedding-sharding and /internals/benchmarks#tilde-8b. Spellcheck OK.
Mira Patel: fixed anchors and pushed. Formatting check passed locally.
Dana Kim: one tiny nit: in "Known limits" table add a blank line above the table to avoid render flakiness.
Mira Patel: fixed. Ready for review.
Evan Ortiz: LGTM. Dana?
Dana Kim: approving.
Samira (docs-bot): Merge window OK (02:00-09:00 UTC). No conflicts.
Mira Patel: merging in morning after CI passes.
Samira (docs-bot): PR merged by Mira Patel at 4512301580. Changelog: "tilde-8b: link fixes, seq limits callout, SDK snippet update"
